about: Video 002 The Last Request: the shot list, shared by the picture (engine/src/scenes/lastrequest/timeline.ts) and the sound (engine/tools/mix_lastrequest.py). Times in seconds; the end card is an overlay from timing.json cardFrom.

shots.why: You think you're not being punished...: rain running down his window at night
Look closely: his prayer mat, untouched, dust on it in the cold window light
deprived of your Qiyam al-Layl: 3 a.m., he lies in bed scrolling, the clock above him
your daily Qur'an recitation: the mushaf closed on the top shelf, dust on it
your sunnah prayers: the clock's hands racing; the prayer tracker at 0/5
your tongue no longer remembers Allah: his prayer beads lying untouched by the bed while he scrolls
your heart is slowly closing off: the whole room, him small in it; the light flickers
So when are you gonna wake up?: the light dies, then the phone; darkness
63:10 And spend from what We have provided you: his laptop on the bed, the bank screen, work notifications
...his mushaf closed on the shelf under dust
before death approaches one of you: rain on a hospital window at night
the monitor's line
and he says: him in the hospital bed; the room goes dark
My Lord, if only You would delay me: the empty bed in the dark (no being is shown)
for a brief term: his dusty prayer mat, his phone lighting up on it, nobody answering
so I would give charity...: across his dark room, everything left behind
...and be of the righteous: the rain on his window, the stopped clock
63:11 But never will Allah delay a soul: lightning on the empty room
when its time has come: the janazah in the rain, the shrouded body, umbrellas
low: feet in the mud, the bier above
And Allah is Aware of what you do: the grave by a lantern, soil falling
the camera rises as everyone walks away; the grave alone in the rain
the grave in fog, the camera pulls far back into darkness
